width-sm.$description: Modal Sizes 'SM' (modalSizeData 'sm') — single-decision destructive confirms, two buttons, no scrolling. No Spacing-ramp step is close enough to snap to (ramp: 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 18, 22, 32, 44) — a component-specific exception, the same category as --popover-panel-width. Proposed as-is pending the token decisions ticket, flagged in the PR (LDS-040).

width-md.$description: Modal Sizes 'MD' (modalSizeData 'md') — the default: a short form or a decision needing a paragraph of context. Same non-ramp exception as --modal-width-sm, flagged in the PR (LDS-040).

width-lg.$description: Modal Sizes 'LG' (modalSizeData 'lg') — dense content that must stay modal: side-by-side comparisons, a table of affected records, a diff. Same non-ramp exception as --modal-width-sm, flagged in the PR (LDS-040).
